snippet.title: CRABS MUST DIE! Demo Trailer (2025) Gameplay Trailer | PC | Steam
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3843400
It's a game about killing crabs on a sci-fi wasteland. That's the pitch.

This is the free demo for CRABS MUST DIE!, a compact open-world shooter developed entirely by one person. It has RPG perks, survival scavenging, and a rusty bike. It's a quick, funny, post-apocalyptic experience, not perfect, but it's got heart and an unhealthy obsession with crustaceans.

If you like low-budget sci-fi and shooting weird things, the demo is waiting.
